name: album
description: Save, find and send pictures from this persona's album. This is the plain picture library, kept separate from the meme library: use it for images worth keeping that are NOT reaction memes — portraits and reference art of the persona, generated images the user liked, screenshots, diagrams, photos the user asked you to keep. Prefer it over manage_meme whenever the user says "keep this", "save this picture" or "remember this image": memes get picked automatically when a reaction is called for, so a non-meme in that library pollutes the picking. action=save copies the file in and records a name, description and tags — write a real description, it is the only thing search can match on later. action=search finds entries by keyword across name, description and tags; action=list shows everything, newest first. action=show sends the picture, rendering it in the terminal and delivering it in the WebUI; pass the id from search or list. action=delete drops the entry, and only hard_delete=true removes the file itself. Ids are short and stable. Search first unless the user gave an exact id. The album is per-persona: each persona has its own, they never mix.

action.description: save takes a picture in; search finds by keyword; list shows everything newest first; show sends one; delete drops an entry.

path.description: Required for save: the image file to take in. Absolute or ~/ path; relative paths resolve against the workspace.

name.description: For save: short human name. Defaults to the file name.

description.description: For save: what is in the picture. Write a real one — search only matches name, description and tags.

tags.description: For save: tags for later search, e.g. ["persona", "portrait"].

query.description: Required for search: keyword matched against name, description and tags.

id.description: Required for show and delete: the entry id from search or list. A name works too when unambiguous.

hard_delete.description: For delete: also remove the image file. Default false (entry only).

limit.description: For list and search: max entries, 1-50. Default 20.
